text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon ran through the Oka Sho in 
magnificent style. She thoroughly enjoyed 
the fiercely contested Triple Tiara race 
where everyone gave it their all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, it seemed Narita Brian would 
run in the Satsuki Sho. Not wanting to be 
outdone, Hishi Amazon fired herself up for 
the upcoming Oaks.
